issues.description: Farm.animals collection type and uniqueness requirement are inconsistent across artifacts. The problem statement (Part 3) explicitly requires a Set implemented as a HashSet to ensure unique animals without duplicates, but the solution implements `private List<Animal> animals` initialized with `new ArrayList<>()`, which allows duplicates. This mismatch can mislead students about which data structure is expected and what behavior (uniqueness) tests might enforce.
issues.suggestedFix: Align requirement and reference implementation. Prefer updating the solution to match the statement: use `private Set<Animal> animals;` with `animals = new HashSet<>();` and update getter/setter/addAnimal signatures accordingly (and define uniqueness semantics via equals/hashCode if needed). Alternatively, if List is intended, remove the "unique/no duplicates" and "Set/HashSet" requirement from the problem statement.
